recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further FHIR-core source work is needed for FHIR-32070 unless the work group wants a future purely editorial heading rename.
issue_request: FHIR-32070 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core request to clean up the Search page Summary Table because it mixed search parameter types, common search parameters, search-result query parameters, and generic interaction parameters. The accepted resolution called for treating the top-level summary table as navigation/table-of-contents material, adding links to the relevant sections, providing consistent navigation for each search parameter type, and working through the details before FHIR-I approval.
initial_application: Commit 6de659813447c8357c3c567cc7a730264c2741e6 appears to have applied the issue by removing the old single mixed "Summary Table" grid from source/search.html, retaining and splitting the dedicated Summary Tables section, adding missing anchors such as _containedType and _text, and pointing entries at detailed parameter sections. Later history, especially FHIR-41459, refined the Contents link target for Summary Tables.
additional_context: The Search page is active build source through source/hierarchy.xml, and source/fhir.ini explicitly notes that search.html summary tables must be maintained when search-rules mappings change. FHIR-I minutes record assignment to Gino to work through proposals and discuss on Zulip, followed by a May 2022 13-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote. Searches found no direct FHIR-32070 Zulip thread or later conflicting decision. FHIR-41459 is already represented on the combined branch and confirms the Contents item should link to #table rather than the _summary subsection.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already removes the confusing mixed table, provides Contents navigation with direct links to search parameter type and standard/search-control sections, and keeps separate Summary Tables for common parameters, search-control parameters, and the datatype-to-search-type cross-map. Renaming the existing "Contents" heading to "Table of Contents" would be editorial-only and would not change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the Search page Contents item for Summary Tables to link to #table instead of #summary; it is already represented by audit commit 012d383235d18d848a0ba55b6b4b8888899b547a on the combined branch.
FHIR-I minutes mention it as related to broader Search page structure work, but it was not necessary to decide the bounded FHIR-32070 cleanup audit.
